title: SC-MT008-DeliveryReceipts

scope.summary:
GOAL: Give every steer message an honest delivery truth: an ack state machine (Sent -> Delivered -> Executed, with Unknown as the typed degraded floor), message-id correlation against transport echoes (e.g. Claude Code --replay-user-messages, which re-emits accepted user messages on the stream-json stdout so the harness can confirm the CLI actually received them), an at-least-once resend policy whose duplicate safety comes from MT-002's id-based suppression, and typed degradation when the transport lacks the DeliveryAck capability (MT-003) — the system must never claim Delivered on a transport that cannot prove it.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: (a) new file src/backend/handshake_core/src/agent_sessions/receipts.rs; (b) store.rs append-only extension: agent_steer_receipts table + CRUD; (c) pub use in agent_sessions/mod.rs; (d) new test file src/backend/handshake_core/tests/agent_sessions_receipts_tests.rs. No transport code (adapter families own the echo parsing wire-up; this MT owns the correlation/state core and its seams).

SPEC CATALOG:

- pub enum AckState { Sent, Delivered, Executed, Unknown } — serde snake_case. Semantics: Sent = frame handed to the MT-004 stdin writer (write_frame returned Ok); Delivered = transport echoed/acknowledged receipt (replay correlation matched); Executed = the steer demonstrably influenced a turn (a TurnItem::SteerMessage with this message_id was appended to a turn by the runtime); Unknown = transport lacks DeliveryAck — the honest floor, never upgraded by guesswork.
- MONOTONIC LADDER (normative): Sent -> Delivered -> Executed only; pub fn can_advance(from: AckState, to: AckState) -> bool; regression attempts return typed AckRegression error; Executed is terminal; Unknown is assigned AT CREATION for degraded transports and never transitions (a degraded receipt that later gets evidence is a NEW receipt generation — keeps the degradation truthful in history).
- pub struct SteerDeliveryReceipt { pub message_id: SteerMessageId, pub session_id: SessionId, pub state: AckState, pub degraded: Option<AckDegradation>, pub transport_echo_id: Option<String>, pub sent_at_utc: Option<DateTime<Utc>>, pub delivered_at_utc: Option<DateTime<Utc>>, pub executed_at_utc: Option<DateTime<Utc>>, pub resend_count: u32, pub updated_at_utc: DateTime<Utc> }.
- pub struct AckDegradation { pub reason: String (pinned constant REASON_TRANSPORT_LACKS_DELIVERY_ACK = "transport_lacks_delivery_ack"), pub adapter_kind: AgentAdapterKind, pub decided_at_utc: DateTime<Utc> }.
- pub enum ReceiptError (thiserror): AckRegression { message_id, from: String, to: String }, ReceiptNotFound(SteerMessageId), Store(#[from] SurrealStoreError).
- pub struct ReceiptLedger { store-backed + in-memory index } : pub async fn open_receipt(&self, session_id, message_id, caps: &AdapterCapabilities) -> SteerDeliveryReceipt — checks caps.has(DeliveryAck): absent => state=Unknown + degraded=Some(..) immediately (typed degradation, test-pinned); present => state=Sent when the queue drain hands the frame to stdin; pub async fn mark_delivered(&self, message_id, transport_echo_id: Option<String>); pub async fn mark_executed(&self, message_id); both enforce can_advance and are idempotent for repeats of the SAME state (at-least-once echoes must not error).
- CORRELATION: pub struct ReplayCorrelator { pending: VecDeque<(SteerMessageId, String)> } — pub fn note_sent(&mut self, message_id, text: &str); pub fn correlate(&mut self, echoed_user_text: &str) -> Option<SteerMessageId> — matches by exact text equality against the OLDEST pending entry first (FIFO — matches MT-002's ordering guarantee and Claude's in-order replay), removing on match; ambiguous duplicates of identical text resolve to the oldest unacked (documented; ordering makes this deterministic). The adapter family feeds correlate() from parsed replay lines — grounding: the structured stdout pipeline already parses claude user envelopes into typed activities (agent_activity.rs parse_line line 125, claude user message.content handling lines 154-172), so the echo hookup is a thin adapter-side call, not new parsing here.
- RESEND POLICY: pub struct ResendPolicy { pub max_resends: u32 (default 2), pub resend_after: Duration (default 30s) } + pub fn resend_due(receipt: &SteerDeliveryReceipt, policy: &ResendPolicy, now) -> bool — true only when state==Sent (never Delivered/Executed/Unknown), elapsed>resend_after, resend_count<max_resends. Executing a resend = re-enqueue the SAME message_id through MT-002 (whose seen_ids suppression makes an actually-delivered duplicate a typed no-op) + increment resend_count on the receipt. Exhausted resends leave state=Sent with a pinned diagnostic marker resend_exhausted=true field — honest: NOT Unknown (transport claims acks), NOT Failed (delivery may still occur late).
- store.rs append-only: table agent_steer_receipts (message_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision BIGINT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, degraded BOOLEAN NOT NULL, resend_count BIGINT NOT NULL, record_json typed SurrealDB object NOT NULL, updated_at_unix_ms BIGINT NOT NULL) — record_json schema_id "hsk.agent_steer_receipt@1", revision-bump upsert (model_lane.rs pattern L91-118); fns upsert_receipt/load_receipt/list_receipts_for_session.

STEP-BY-STEP IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Read MT-002 steer_queue.rs (EnqueueOutcome::DuplicateSuppressed, resend_of provenance), MT-003 capabilities.rs (DeliveryAck flag, has()), MT-004 write_frame Ok semantics, agent_activity.rs claude user-envelope parsing L154-172.
2. Implement AckState + can_advance + the receipt/degradation/error types with serde wire pins.
3. Implement ReceiptLedger over the appended store table; same-state idempotency; regression typed error.
4. Implement ReplayCorrelator with FIFO text matching; document the oldest-first ambiguity rule.
5. Implement ResendPolicy + resend_due + the re-enqueue helper pub async fn execute_resend(queue: &SharedSteerQueue, ledger: &ReceiptLedger, receipt: &SteerDeliveryReceipt) -> Result<EnqueueOutcome, ReceiptError> which increments resend_count regardless of Queued vs DuplicateSuppressed (both are correct at-least-once outcomes).
6. Author tests/agent_sessions_receipts_tests.rs: (a) ladder tests — every legal advance, every illegal regression typed; same-state idempotent repeat OK; (b) degraded open on a DeliveryAck-less capability set => Unknown + reason pinned, and mark_delivered on it => AckRegression-class typed refusal (Unknown never transitions); (c) correlator: 3 sent, echoes arrive in order => FIFO match; duplicate identical texts => oldest first; unmatched echo => None; (d) resend_due matrix over state x elapsed x count; execute_resend on an already-delivered message => DuplicateSuppressed path with no receipt regression; (e) exhausted resends => resend_exhausted=true, state still Sent; (f) SurrealDB receipt round-trip (managed-SurrealDB gated, typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF skip); (g) Executed via a TurnItem::SteerMessage append driving mark_executed.
7. cargo build + clippy green.
forbidden_paths: src/backend/handshake_core/src/model_runtime/** (echo parsing wire-up belongs to adapter families)
acceptance_criteria: AckState ladder Sent->Delivered->Executed is monotonic with typed AckRegression on any regression; same-state repeats are idempotent — proven by ladder tests.

A transport without DeliveryAck yields state=Unknown with degradation reason transport_lacks_delivery_ack at receipt creation, and Unknown NEVER transitions — proven by test (b); the system can never claim Delivered without transport evidence.
ReplayCorrelator matches echoes FIFO oldest-first (deterministic under duplicate texts) and returns None for unmatched echoes — proven by test (c).

resend_due fires only for state==Sent within max_resends after resend_after; execute_resend re-uses the SAME message_id through MT-002 so a late-delivered original makes the resend a typed DuplicateSuppressed no-op — proven by tests (d).
Exhausted resends produce resend_exhausted=true while honestly remaining Sent — proven by test (e).
Receipts persist via revision-bump upsert with schema_id hsk.agent_steer_receipt@1; SurrealDB round-trip proven (managed-SurrealDB gated).
store.rs changes append-only; cargo build green; clippy clean.
proof_targets: cargo test -p handshake_core agent_sessions_receipts --nocapture 2>&1 | tee /tmp/mt008_run.txt && grep -E 'test result: ok' /tmp/mt008_run.txt
expected_tests: monotonic ladder + idempotent repeats + typed regressions
FIFO replay correlation incl. duplicate-text determinism
resend_due matrix + same-id resend duplicate-safety + exhaustion honesty
implementation_notes: Why Executed is core-observable: the runtime appends TurnItem::SteerMessage{message_id,...} (MT-001) when a steer is consumed into a turn; mark_executed keys off that append, so Executed never depends on transport goodwill.

Claude correlation grounding: --replay-user-messages re-emits accepted user messages as user envelopes on stream-json stdout; the existing parser (agent_activity.rs L154-172) already surfaces them as typed activities — the MT-021+ adapter forwards the echoed text into ReplayCorrelator::correlate. Codex app-server acks turn/steer responses directly (RPC result = Delivered). ACP: no ack channel => DeliveryAck absent => Unknown floor.

Text-equality correlation is deliberate v1: message ids are NOT injected into the steer text (would pollute the model's context); FIFO order + exact text is deterministic given MT-002 ordering. If a transport later carries metadata ids, transport_echo_id upgrades the match precision without changing the state machine.

resend_exhausted stays Sent by design: claiming Failed would be unproven (delivery may complete late), claiming Unknown would misuse the degradation type; MT-009 emits the exhaustion event for operator visibility.
HBR-SWARM-004: message_id is the required correlation id on every receipt row and every MT-009 ack event; requires_ack semantics live in this MT's types.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless ack/receipt core; ack states surface to operators via MT-009 bus events and the GUI family's session pane.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Internal receipt mechanics; the operator-facing meaning of ack states (Sent/Delivered/Executed/Unknown badges) is documented when the GUI family surfaces them, building on MT-007's manual entry.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations: internal_diagnostics (may be typed DEFERRED if the internal-diagnostics tier is not yet shipped for agent_sessions)
palmistry (may be typed DEFERRED if palmistry wiring is not yet shipped for agent_sessions)
risk_if_missed: Steering becomes faith-based: the operator cannot distinguish delivered from dropped instructions, resends double-execute without id suppression guarantees, and transports without acks silently masquerade as reliable — the exact trust failure that makes multi-agent steering unusable.

risks: RISK-1: Fabricated Delivered — upgrading acks from timeouts or optimistic assumptions on transports that never echoed, lying to the operator.
RISK-2: Double execution via resend — resending with a NEW message id (or bypassing the queue) defeats duplicate suppression and the agent runs the instruction twice.
RISK-3: Mis-correlation — echo text matching pairs an echo with the wrong pending steer when texts collide, marking the wrong message Delivered.
RISK-4: State regression — a late Sent-write after Delivered (async race) silently downgrades the receipt.
RISK-5: Degradation erosion — code paths treating Unknown as 'probably fine' and building on it as if Delivered.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): Delivered requires a correlate() match or an explicit transport RPC ack; no timer-based upgrades exist in the API; test (b) pins the Unknown floor.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): execute_resend re-enqueues the SAME SteerMessageId through MT-002; test (d) proves DuplicateSuppressed on late delivery.
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): FIFO oldest-first deterministic rule, documented + test (c) with duplicate texts; transport_echo_id field ready for precision upgrades.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): can_advance enforced inside the ledger (single write path) with typed AckRegression; ladder tests cover async-shaped repeats.
CTRL-5 (RISK-5): Unknown is a creation-time terminal with a pinned reason; mark_* on Unknown is a typed refusal; grep proof for the pinned reason constant.
